# Pipeline

We used the pipeline downloaded here https://github.com/y9c/m6A-CAMseq

Since caslake doesn't connected to the internet, we downloaded the docker image using 

```
apptainer pull camseq.sif docker://y9ch/camseq
```

Then we submitted the job using:  

```
#!/bin/bash

#SBATCH --account=pi-xinhe
#SBATCH --partition=caslake
#SBATCH --mem=100G
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=24
#SBATCH --output=out/pipeline.out
#SBATCH --job-name=RNAseq_pipeline

module load apptainer
module load python


apptainer run -B /project camseq.sif -c data.yaml -j 24
```

The `data.yaml` file is 


```
# project specific parameters including data and reference
workdir: workspace
cores: 64

# can be "ECLIP10", "ECLIP6", "TAKARAV3", "SACSEQV3", "STRANDED"
libtype: STRANDED

# by default, the pipeline will use the strandness information from the library
# if the strandness is not available, set the strandness to `false`
# strandness: true

# by default, the pipeline will force remove the PCR duplicates based on the UMI
# if UMI is not available, you can toggle the markdup to `false` to skip the PCR duplicate removal
# markdup: true

# TODO: if the genome index is not available, the pipeline will build it automatically
genome_index: /project/xinhe/xsun/camseq/data/reference/genome/hisat2_tx_3n/GRCh38.release110

reference:
  genes:
    - /project/xinhe/xsun/camseq/data/reference/gene/Human_rRNA_5S_250123.fa
  genome:
    -  /project/xinhe/xsun/camseq/data/reference/genome/GRCh38.release110.fa

samples:
  241217AVITI-He-lab-24JX-12-1-6:
    - R1: raw_reads/241217AVITI-He-lab-24JX-12-1-6_R1.fastq.gz
      R2: raw_reads/241217AVITI-He-lab-24JX-12-1-6_R2.fastq.gz
```


# Reference 

The rRNA fa file and genome index files were shared by Yanming Chen, from Chuan's lab 

The genome fa file GRCh38.release110.fa was downloaded from http://ftp.ensembl.org/pub/release-110/fasta/homo_sapiens/dna/

```
wget http://ftp.ensembl.org/pub/release-110/fasta/homo_sapiens/dna/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.dna.primary_assembly.fa.gz
```
